```{r}
# PERCENT SURVIVAL
# Function for summarising survival standard error
summarySE <- function(data=NULL, measurevar=NULL, groupvars=NULL, na.rm=FALSE,
                      conf.interval=.95, .drop=TRUE) {
  require(plyr)
  
  # New version of length which can handle NA's: if na.rm==T, don't count them
  length2 <- function (x, na.rm=FALSE) {
    if (na.rm==TRUE) sum(!is.na(x))
    else       length(x)
  }
  
  # This does the summary. For each group's data frame, return a vector with
  # N, mean, and sd
  datac <- ddply(data, groupvars, .drop=.drop,
                 .fun = function(xx, col) {
                   c(N    = length2(xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm),
                     mean = mean   (xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm),
                     sd   = sd     (xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm)
                   )
                 },
                 measurevar
  )
  
  # Commenting this rename mean column line, as not assigning measurevar name properly
  # # Rename the "mean" column    
  # datac <- rename(datac, measurevar = mean)
  
  datac$se <- datac$sd / sqrt(datac$N)  # Calculate standard error of the mean
  
  # Confidence interval multiplier for standard error
  # Calculate t-statistic for confidence interval: 
  # e.g., if conf.interval is .95, use .975 (above/below), and use df=N-1
  ciMult <- qt(conf.interval/2 + .5, datac$N-1)
  datac$ci <- datac$se * ciMult
  
  return(datac)
}
```

```{r}
theme_Publication <- function(base_size=14, base_family="arial") {
      library(grid)
      library(ggthemes)
      (theme_foundation(base_size=base_size, base_family=base_family)
       + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
               text = element_text(),
               panel.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               panel.border = element_rect(colour = NA),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = rel(1)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust =2),
               axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
               axis.text = element_text(), 
               axis.line = element_line(colour="black"),
               axis.ticks = element_line(),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="#f0f0f0"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
               legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.direction = "horizontal",
               legend.key.size= unit(0.2, "cm"),
               legend.margin = unit(0, "cm"),
               legend.title = element_text(face="italic"),
               plot.margin=unit(c(10,5,5,5),"mm"),
               strip.background=element_rect(colour="#f0f0f0",fill="#f0f0f0"),
               strip.text = element_text(face="bold")
          ))
      
}
```

```{r}
## Shared workflow for larvae and juveniles: regional sire/dam contributions

library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)

inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

compute_parent_region_summary <- function(fit, dad_name = "Dad", mom_name = "Mom") {
  # Posterior draws for intercept
  draws_df <- as_draws_df(fit)
  b_int    <- as.numeric(dplyr::pull(draws_df, b_Intercept))  # length = n_draws
  
  ## ---------- Sires ----------
  re_sire_arr <- ranef(fit, summary = FALSE)[[dad_name]][, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
  sire_levels <- dimnames(re_sire_arr)[[2]]
  
  sire_regions <- tibble(parent = sire_levels) %>%
    mutate(
      Region = case_when(
        grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", parent) ~ "Central",
        grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", parent)    ~ "North",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  
  re_sire_mat <- re_sire_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
  if (is.vector(re_sire_mat)) re_sire_mat <- matrix(re_sire_mat, ncol = 1)
  
  logit_sire <- sweep(re_sire_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
  prob_sire  <- inv_logit(logit_sire)
  
  idx_north_sire   <- which(sire_regions$Region == "North")
  idx_central_sire <- which(sire_regions$Region == "Central")
  
  north_mean_draws_sire   <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_north_sire,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  central_mean_draws_sire <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_central_sire, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  x_percent_sire_draws <- (north_mean_draws_sire - central_mean_draws_sire) /
                          central_mean_draws_sire * 100
  
  p_sire <- mean(x_percent_sire_draws > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  sire_row <- tibble(
    Group = "Sires",
    Mean_percent_difference = mean(x_percent_sire_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower_95 = quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Upper_95 = quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_North_greater = p_sire
  )
  
  ## ---------- Dams ----------
  re_dam_arr <- ranef(fit, summary = FALSE)[[mom_name]][, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
  dam_levels <- dimnames(re_dam_arr)[[2]]
  
  dam_regions <- tibble(parent = dam_levels) %>%
    mutate(
      Region = case_when(
        grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", parent) ~ "Central",
        grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", parent)    ~ "North",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  
  re_dam_mat <- re_dam_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
  if (is.vector(re_dam_mat)) re_dam_mat <- matrix(re_dam_mat, ncol = 1)
  
  logit_dam <- sweep(re_dam_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
  prob_dam  <- inv_logit(logit_dam)
  
  idx_north_dam   <- which(dam_regions$Region == "North")
  idx_central_dam <- which(dam_regions$Region == "Central")
  
  north_mean_draws_dam   <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_north_dam,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  central_mean_draws_dam <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_central_dam, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  x_percent_dam_draws <- (north_mean_draws_dam - central_mean_draws_dam) /
                         central_mean_draws_dam * 100
  
  p_dam <- mean(x_percent_dam_draws > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  dam_row <- tibble(
    Group = "Dams",
    Mean_percent_difference = mean(x_percent_dam_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower_95 = quantile(x_percent_dam_draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Upper_95 = quantile(x_percent_dam_draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_North_greater = p_dam
  )
  
  bind_rows(sire_row, dam_row)
}
```

```{r}
## Planned contrasts: North vs Central (Sires vs Dams) for larvae & juveniles

logit <- function(p) log(p / (1 - p))

compute_parent_region_contrasts <- function(fit, dad_name = "Dad", mom_name = "Mom") {
  # Posterior draws for intercept
  draws_df <- as_draws_df(fit)
  b_int    <- as.numeric(dplyr::pull(draws_df, b_Intercept))

  ## ---------- Sires ----------
  re_sire_arr <- ranef(fit, summary = FALSE)[[dad_name]][, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
  sire_levels <- dimnames(re_sire_arr)[[2]]

  sire_regions <- tibble(parent = sire_levels) %>%
    mutate(
      Region = case_when(
        grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", parent) ~ "Central",
        grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", parent)    ~ "North",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  re_sire_mat <- re_sire_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
  if (is.vector(re_sire_mat)) re_sire_mat <- matrix(re_sire_mat, ncol = 1)

  logit_sire <- sweep(re_sire_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
  prob_sire  <- inv_logit(logit_sire)

  idx_north_sire   <- which(sire_regions$Region == "North")
  idx_central_sire <- which(sire_regions$Region == "Central")

  north_mean_draws_sire   <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_north_sire,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  central_mean_draws_sire <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_central_sire, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

  or_sire <- exp(logit(north_mean_draws_sire) - logit(central_mean_draws_sire))

  ## ---------- Dams ----------
  re_dam_arr <- ranef(fit, summary = FALSE)[[mom_name]][, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
  dam_levels <- dimnames(re_dam_arr)[[2]]

  dam_regions <- tibble(parent = dam_levels) %>%
    mutate(
      Region = case_when(
        grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", parent) ~ "Central",
        grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", parent)    ~ "North",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  re_dam_mat <- re_dam_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
  if (is.vector(re_dam_mat)) re_dam_mat <- matrix(re_dam_mat, ncol = 1)

  logit_dam <- sweep(re_dam_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
  prob_dam  <- inv_logit(logit_dam)

  idx_north_dam   <- which(dam_regions$Region == "North")
  idx_central_dam <- which(dam_regions$Region == "Central")

  north_mean_draws_dam   <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_north_dam,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  central_mean_draws_dam <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_central_dam, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

  or_dam <- exp(logit(north_mean_draws_dam) - logit(central_mean_draws_dam))

  ## ---------- Summarise contrasts (North vs Central) ----------
  parent_or_draws <- tibble(
    Group = c(rep("Sires", length(or_sire)), rep("Dams", length(or_dam))),
    or    = c(or_sire, or_dam)
  )

  parent_or_draws %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      median_hdci(or),
      Pl = mean(or < 1),
      Pg = mean(or > 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

## Apply to larvae and juveniles (uses the same planned contrast structure)
larv_contrasts <- compute_parent_region_contrasts(fit_larv, dad_name = "Dad", mom_name = "Mom")
juv_contrasts  <- compute_parent_region_contrasts(fit_juv,  dad_name = "Dad", mom_name = "Mum")

larv_contrasts
juv_contrasts
```

Larvae plot
```{r}
inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

# Posterior predicted survival (per parent, per draw) for larvae
larv_emm_draws <- bind_rows(
  # Sires (Dad)
  fit_larv %>%
    spread_draws(b_Intercept, r_Dad[Parent, Intercept]) %>%
    mutate(
      ParentType = "Sires",
      Region = case_when(
        grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Parent) ~ "Central",
        grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Parent)    ~ "North",
        TRUE                                        ~ NA_character_
      ),
      prob = inv_logit(b_Intercept + r_Dad)
    ),
  # Dams (Mom)
  fit_larv %>%
    spread_draws(b_Intercept, r_Mom[Parent, Intercept]) %>%
    mutate(
      ParentType = "Dams",
      Region = case_when(
        grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Parent) ~ "Central",
        grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Parent)    ~ "North",
        TRUE                                        ~ NA_character_
      ),
      prob = inv_logit(b_Intercept + r_Mom)
    )
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Region))

# Per-draw EMM within each ParentType × Region
larv_group_draws <- larv_emm_draws %>%
  group_by(.draw, ParentType, Region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(emm = mean(prob), .groups = "drop")

# Per-draw grand EMM (across all parents, both sexes, both regions)
larv_grand_draws <- larv_emm_draws %>%
  group_by(.draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(grand_emm = mean(prob), .groups = "drop")

# Deviance draws
larv_dev_draws <- larv_group_draws %>%
  left_join(larv_grand_draws, by = ".draw") %>%
  mutate(
    dev = emm - grand_emm,
    ParentType = factor(ParentType, levels = c("Dams", "Sires")),
    Region     = factor(Region, levels = c("Central", "North"))
  )

# 4 boxplots: grouped by ParentType, coloured by Region (deviance scale)
larv_dev_plot<-
ggplot(larv_dev_draws, aes(x = ParentType, y = dev, fill = Region)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Central" = "#3182bd", "North" = "#f21a00")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    x = "Parent",
    y = "EMM deviance",
    fill = "Region"
  )
larv_dev_plot
```
